title: Footloose
about: A city teenager moves to a small town where dancing is banned, and decides to change that.
cue: Serve the snacks when Ren starts teaching Willard to dance.
faces: Dinner first. Then we take the party to the grain mill, just over the county line, where nobody can stop us.
